feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 June 2026 4:45pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 07 June 2026 at 4:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of the British Isles, with an associated front crossing our area overnight.


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, decreasing 4 or 5 later this evening or early tonight, veering west or northwest 3 or 4 later tonight, then backing southwest tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, turning heavy at times. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor at times in the rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mostly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, showers soon developing.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
